svg.aria-label: Profile Motion Reel: a 30-second looping SVG reel with seven scenes — typed terminal boot, kinetic type, orbit with gauges, scrolling ticker with stacked language bar, self-drawing timeline, growing defect bar chart, and an outro. Built with SMIL and CSS only, no scripts.
